AI-response-validation alternative flow details:
A1 schema failure → reject response, record schema errors, trigger AI-failure handling;
A2 unsupported category → reject/flag category; return invalid if required categories remain incomplete;
A3 out-of-range/missing score → reject without inventing, clamping, or silent correction;
A4 unsupported evidence ref → warn and reject/flag affected proposal;
A5 hard-rule/rubric conflict → retain proposed value, record adjustment, mark review;
A6 low confidence/incomplete rationale → warn and mark review. AI-assisted-analysis alternatives:
A1 missing model/prompt/schema/credential; A2 API error/rate-limit/timeout;
A3 empty/provider error response; A4 validation rejects complete response. AI-failure A3 storage failure: preserve safe failure in parent transaction/logging
path for later idempotent persistence. No raw secrets are exposed.

or response invalid?
A1-A4
Validated response

Risk-calculation alternatives:
A1 configuration error → unable-to-calculate;
A2 incomplete accepted AI input → warning and authority review;
A3 hard-rule conflict → retain proposed/adjusted values and continue;
A4 non-finite/out-of-range/inconsistent result → reject result. Constraints represented by this path:
versioned formula/weights/thresholds/rules; same validated input/configuration
produces the same result; adjustments are never silent; no authority decision.

A2 retrieval failure → failed/insufficient-data, store safe audit, end;
A3 gate not ready → provisional path or skip AI/risk/resources and require review;
A4 AI failure → , no fabricated scores, consolidate review-required;
A5 calculation failure → preserve warnings, risk unavailable;
A6 resource failure → store unavailable item/status;
A7 final storage conflict → cancel stale publication, bounded idempotent retry. Storage alternatives:
A1 transaction
start failure → bounded idempotent retry;
A2 input/claim changed → abort and do not publish stale result;
A3 commit conflict → reload guard and retry within policy;
A4 unavailable AI/resource → store explicit status/provenance, never omit silently.

View-use-case alternatives:
Risk-assessment-view A1 unauthorised → message “You are not authorised to view this assessment”;
A2 processing/failed/absent → show safe state; A3 legacy/stale → label and do not show current;
A4 restricted evidence → deny request, keep summary; A5 leave page → no data change. Resource-view A1 unauthorised; A2 processing/absent/failed; A3 stale/legacy;
A4 item unavailable/review-required → show reason, no fabricated default; A5 leave page. AI-analysis-view A1 unauthorised; A2 unavailable/invalid/retryable → safe status, no rejected raw output;

A3 stale/other input → label legacy; A4 restricted evidence → indicator only; A5 leave page. Organiser-summary-view A1 unauthorised; A2 processing/unavailable/failed/absent → safe status, no invented result;
A3 stale input → label stale; A4 restricted field → safe fields only; A5 leave page. All viewing constraints: role-based least privilege; current/processing/failed/incomplete/
stale states are distinct; viewing never changes assessment, resources, or authority decisions.
